spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A sort of potherb, (Chironia centauroides, &c.)
E.
लुटि to be prostrate, &c., aff. क्वुन्.

m. (-कः)
A robber, a thief.
E.
लुटि to rob, काकन् aff.

f. (-ण्टा)
A horse's rolling himself on the ground.
E.
लुटि or लुठि to roll on the ground, aff. अङ् and टाप्; also लुण्ठा and लुण्ठि.

mfn. (-ण्ठन्-ण्ठन्ती-ण्ठत्)
Rolling on the ground.
E.
लुठि to roll, &c. शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Rolling on the ground.
E.
लुठि To roll on the ground, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-ण्ठा)
A horse's rolling on the ground: see the last, and लुण्टा.

m. (-कः)
A crow.
E.
लुठि to roll on the ground, काकन् aff.

f. (-ण्ठी)
A horse's rolling himself on the ground.
E.
लुठि to roll on the ground, aff. अच् and ङीप्.

f. (-ण्डी)
Observing the rules of princely conduct, acting and judging rightly.
E.
लुडि to be agitated, &c., aff. अच् and ङीप्; also with कन् added, fem. form लुण्डिका.
